name: dbt
summary: Run dbt build on a verified dbt project bundle in the operator sandbox, against a DuckDB database Ogun generates, and keep run_results.json, manifest.json and the database as artifacts.

settings.name: select
settings.label: Node selection
settings.help: Passed to dbt build --select. Letters, digits and _ . : + * @ , / - and spaces, at most 512 characters.

egress.note: None. The dbt operator runs with the sandbox network denied; it needs no warehouse and reaches nothing outside the machine.

implementation.evidence: The manifest is compiled into ogun-ops and the shim is in ogun-op-shims. IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS does not mention dbt, and no test in the repository runs dbt.

notes: This is Ogun's builtin dbt@1 operator, not an adapter. It runs a code bundle referenced by content hash and needs a human approval bound to the workflow hash. dbt with the dbt-duckdb adapter must be installed. Ogun does not pretend to be a warehouse (ADR 0012).
